overview: In the morning you kept to the uncles while term opened in the City. You were not cast in the afternoon's play. You did not draft the England speech, and you did not write a giant.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Named the morning's limit, and did not draft the speech.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Kept the morning with the uncles

summary: Kept the morning with the uncles
